put:
  operationId: put.workspaces.projects.tasks.cost-rate
  summary: Update the cost rate for a task
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-050000-put.workspaces.projects.tasks.cost-rate-official-path-existence.json
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-050000-put.workspaces.projects.tasks.cost-rate-live-put.json
  x-notes: |
    Live PUT returns 200 with full task object including costRate.
    Official spec param is {id}; ours is {taskId} — cosmetic alias, same path.
    MCP tool clockify_tasks_rates_update dispatches to this path when rate_kind=cost.
    GET probe returned 405 (Spring-MVC path-registered signal).
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: projectId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}, description: Task ID (also aliased as taskId in ours spec)}
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [amount]
          properties:
            amount:
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              description: Rate in minor currency units (cents); 1000 = $10.00/hr
            since:
              type: string
              description: Effective date YYYY-MM-DD (optional)
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Full task object with costRate and hourlyRate embedded
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              name: {type: string}
              projectId: {type: string}
              billable: {type: boolean}
              costRate:
                type: object
                properties:
                  amount: {type: integer}
                  currency: {type: string}
              hourlyRate:
                type: object
                properties:
                  amount: {type: integer}
                  currency: {type: string}
              status: {type: string, enum: [ACTIVE, DONE]}
endpoints.notes: Both official spec and ours document this path. Live PUT confirmed 200 with full task object. The {id} vs {taskId} param name is cosmetic. MCP tool clockify_tasks_rates_update uses this path for rate_kind=cost. GET returns 405 (Spring-MVC confirms path registered for PUT only).
